# Fixture corpus

- `papers/paper_1.pdf`: matchable paper baseline.
- `papers/paper_2.pdf`: scanned/text-poor stand-in for OCR fallback tests.
- `papers/paper_3.pdf`: ambiguous-match stand-in.
- `papers/paper_4.pdf`: figure-heavy stand-in.
- `papers/unmatched_1.pdf`: unmatched stand-in.
- `tables/literature_fixture.csv`: baseline CSV table fixture.
- `tables/literature_fixture.xlsx`: baseline workbook fixture (also used for schema-sheet fallback and early export-oriented tests).
